Fiduciary Trust Company Has Increased Its Holding in Becton Dickinson & Co (BDX) as Stock Declined; Noesis Capital Mangement Has Increased Its Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Market Valuation Declined
May 19, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22 million, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $915.74 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $186.31. About 16.17M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Fiduciary Trust Company increased its stake in Becton Dickinson & Co (BDX) by 6.99% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fiduciary Trust Company bought 5,155 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,911 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.89M, up from 73,756 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fiduciary Trust Company who had been investing in Becton Dickinson & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $60.12B market cap company. The stock increased 0.35% or $0.79 during the last trading session, reaching $225.01. About 1.01 million shares traded. Becton, Dickinson and Company (NYSE:BDX) has risen 15.92% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.37% the S&P500.
Among 20 analysts covering Becton Dickinson ( NYSE:BDX ), 13 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. On Thursday, November 2 the stock rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus with “Buy”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, August 22 by Jefferies. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, April 10 by Citigroup. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Friday, September 22 by RBC Capital Markets. Deutsche Bank maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, December 29 report.
Fiduciary Trust Company, which manages about $3.36 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) by 3,186 shares to 426,332 shares, valued at $59.57M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Home Depot Inc (NYSE:HD) by 12,316 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 276,284 shares, and cut its stake in Vanguard Index Fds (VNQ).
